task.description: Gate docs/agents/design/REQ-003.md per WF-02 Step 1b. Read the design artefact independently (do not read CODE-DESIGNER's handoff result.summary as a substitute). CODE-DESIGNER's design (PASS) proposes: (1) append 'en' to src/i18n/routing.ts's locales array, defaultLocale stays 'ru'; (2) create messages/en.json matching messages/ru.json's 177-leaf-key structure exactly, values duplicated verbatim from ru.json as placeholders; (3) no code change needed to src/i18n/request.ts, src/components/landing/LocaleSwitcher.tsx, or src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx (all already generic over routing.locales) — verify this claim yourself by reading those three files directly, don't take it on trust. One open question was flagged in the design: Metadata.ogLocale's placeholder value — the design proposes 'en_US' by analogy to REQ-001a's ru_RU/uz_UZ precedent, but REQ-003's own requirement text doesn't name this value explicitly. Decide whether this is an acceptable design choice (stated open question, reasonable analogy, not silently resolved) or whether it needs to route back to CODE-DESIGNER/ORCH for an explicit decision before FRONTEND-DEV builds it.
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-003 acceptance criterion has a corresponding design element, no TBD/deferral language
Props/types (n/a here — no new component — confirm and state that explicitly rather than silently skipping the check)

The 'no code change needed' claims for request.ts/LocaleSwitcher.tsx/layout.tsx are independently re-verified against the actual files, not just accepted from the design doc
The ogLocale open question is explicitly resolved one way or the other in this gate's result, not silently passed through
